item.title: Listen: Bristol Unpacked with police and crime commissioner Clare Moody on fixing force culture, and the government axing her role
item.description: Just 18 months into her term, the Labour politician in charge of police scrutiny in Avon and Somerset has, along with peers across the country, been told she represents a 'failed experiment' that will end in 2028. Neil asks Clare Moody how that feels, and what she aims to achieve while still in office.
